title: Lose Yourself mashup
material_description: digital screen recording of @Lyrics_dropzone's TikTok stream
brief_description: Eminem’s Oscar-winning song Lose Yourself (2002) is about pressure, focus and a single moment that can change everything. This video remixes the track using hundreds of film clips – black-and-white classics, animation, blockbusters and videogames – carefully synced with scenes from 8 Mile (2002). Created by YouTube editor The Unusual Suspect, the mashup features 331 characters and has been viewed more than 3 million times. In an age shaped by AI shortcuts and automation, this work highlights editing as a creative artform.
